**Finding submitted: deviation (T4C), fallback target.**

- **Customer convenience right (§3.4, p0044–p0045):** we may terminate the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for convenience on at least one month's notice, effective at month-end — better than the 60–90 day fallback, so already met.
- **Vendor side (§3.3, §3.2):** IBM has no mid-term convenience exit; its only routes are material breach or non-renewal at the end of a term on 90 days' notice, which satisfies both Vendor-side fallback elements. Non-renewal is left to RENEWAL and not double-flagged.
- **Material gap (§3.4(b), p0046):** our convenience right is conditioned on uncapped "early termination charges" in Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments. One surgical insertion adds the fallback cap ("capped at three (3) months' charges") with all other wording preserved.
- Preferred pro-rata refund of prepaid fees is noted in the rationale only, not flagged.
